articles.title: Nanopath: $25 Million Series B To Advance Women’s Health Molecular Testing
articles.snippet:
Nanopath has raised $25 million in Series B financing to advance a 15-minute molecular test for vaginitis and prepare its point-of-care diagnostics platform for potential commercialization. The round includes $2 million in nondilutive grant funding and was co-led by Norwest and SV Health Investors’ MedTech Convergence Fund. The Labcorp Venture Fund participated alongside Elderberry Ventures, GingerBread Capital, Alumni Ventures, and other investors.
The post Nanopath: $25 Million Series B To Advance Women’s Health Molecular Testing appeared first on Pulse 2.0 .
